SHARED_BASTION.Title: Shared Bastion
SHARED_BASTION.Name: Name
SHARED_BASTION.ParticipantHint: Owners of these characters can read the shared bastion and manage their own facilities.
SHARED_BASTION.NoCharacters: Create a character in the Actor Directory first.
SHARED_BASTION.EmptyFacilities: The bastion has no facilities yet.
SHARED_BASTION.StatusHint: Open the shared bastion from the Actor Directory. The project guide documents the current development status.
SHARED_BASTION.FoundationNotice: Development version: Facility operations and scene management are not fully implemented yet.
SHARED_BASTION.Supported: Within target range; runtime acceptance pending

Errors.UnsupportedRuntime: Shared Bastion requires Foundry VTT 14.367 or later within V14 and D&D5e 6.0.x.
Errors.UnverifiedWriteRuntime: Write actions are currently enabled only for the verified Foundry build 14.369.
Errors.InvalidFacility: This facility is not stored on a shared bastion.
Errors.UnsupportedDataVersion: This bastion uses an unsupported data version.
Errors.MissingOwner: The owner character is missing or is not a participant. The GM must repair the assignment.
Errors.InvalidUser: The requesting user is not connected.
Errors.NotOwner: You can only manage facilities belonging to your own characters.
Errors.InvalidOwnerLevel: The owner character's level could not be determined.
Errors.InvalidSize: The facility size is not available in the system configuration.
Errors.InvalidRequest: This bastion action or its inputs are not allowed.
Errors.LevelRequired: The owner character has not reached the required level.
Errors.InvalidOrder: This order is not available for this facility.
Errors.OrderInProgress: The facility is already executing an order.
Errors.InsufficientFunds: The owner character does not have enough currency.
Errors.IntegrationPending: This order workflow is not available in the development version yet.
Errors.NoGM: No GM is connected. The bastion is currently read-only.
Errors.ConnectionRequired: The world connection is unavailable. The bastion is currently read-only.
Errors.RequestTimeout: The bastion action has not been confirmed yet. Check the current facility state before trying again.
Errors.LedgerUnavailable: Bastion operation receipts are unavailable. Please contact the GM.
Errors.Conflict: The facility has changed. Refresh the view and try again.
Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can perform this action.
Errors.BastionExists: This world already has a shared bastion.
Errors.BastionIdOccupied: The reserved bastion ID is already in use. The GM must check the existing actor.
Errors.InvalidBastion: This actor is not a shared bastion.
Errors.ParticipantHasFacilities: This character still owns facilities. Reassign them before removing the participant.
Errors.CommitFailed: The bastion action could not be fully saved. Please check the current state.
Errors.InvalidRules: The rule conditions or exceptions are invalid.
Errors.FacilityLimit: The owner character has reached their special facility limit.
Errors.PrerequisiteRequired: The owner character does not meet all prerequisites for this facility.
Errors.InvalidTemplate: This facility template is unavailable or inaccessible.
Errors.UntrustedTemplate: Players can edit this template. The GM must protect its rule definition first.
Errors.DuplicateFacility: This character already owns this special facility.
Errors.OperationSourceUnavailable: The required item or creature template is missing or inaccessible.
Errors.FacilityDisabled: This facility is currently shut down.
Errors.TradeCapacity: This trade exceeds the available stock or capacity.
Errors.OccupantCapacity: This facility does not have enough spaces.
Errors.InvalidOrderDuration: A valid duration could not be determined for this order.

SHARED_BASTION.EmptyGroup: No facilities in this section yet.
SHARED_BASTION.BuildHint: The owner character pays the cost. Construction starts when confirmed.
SHARED_BASTION.RequirementsHint: One condition per line: tool:smith for tool proficiency, weapon:mar for weapon proficiency, item:identifier for an owned item, spellcasting for a spellcasting class. approval:identifier requires a reasoned GM approval. Add any template prerequisites not modeled by the system here.
SHARED_BASTION.ExceptionHint: Provide a reason for each exception. Empty fields grant no exception. Ownership and costs still apply.
SHARED_BASTION.NoTemplates: No accessible facility templates found. The GM can grant read access to existing world items or appropriate compendiums. Players must not be able to edit their rule definitions.
SHARED_BASTION.RemoveHint: This facility will be removed. Active orders end; previously paid costs are not refunded.
SHARED_BASTION.TemplateRulesHint: Define prerequisites and rule values for new facilities from this template. The definition stays in this world; the original item or compendium is unchanged. Existing facilities keep their current rules.
SHARED_BASTION.Repeatable: Repeatable when permitted by the facility description
SHARED_BASTION.OrderCostHint: Cost and duration are calculated from the selected action and template.
SHARED_BASTION.CancelOrderHint: The current order will end. Previously paid costs are not refunded.
SHARED_BASTION.OccupantsHint: Drag NPCs from the actor directory or an accessible compendium into the slots. Empty slots remain unoccupied.
SHARED_BASTION.CalendarTurnHint: Elapsed calendar days are processed once. This turn adds no extra days and repairs shut-down facilities according to the system rules.
SHARED_BASTION.ManualTurnHint: This turn advances all assigned facilities by the configured duration
